summary: Fast-Castle mounted samurai civ, rated S tier by pros. Japanese players tower their gold, reach Castle around 6:30 and fight with mounted samurai and yumi in about 95% of games.
openings: Fast Castle: Tawara farmhouse, 6 on food and 3 on gold, Kura Storehouse Feudal, 1 to 2 upgraded towers on gold, Castle around 6:30 with the Floating Gate.
Spear rush: 2 spears to cut gold against French and Jeanne, or a spear rush into units against Byzantines.

spikes.label: Castle around 6:30
spikes.detail: Mounted samurai arrive very early, then Yorishiro, a stable and a second Town Center.
spikes.answer: Counter-tower their gold during the fast Castle.

spikes.label: Imperial around 20
spikes.detail: Their map food lasts until about 18 to 20 minutes, then they go Imperial.
spikes.answer: Push before their farmhouses and second Town Center pay off.

scout: Upgraded towers on gold and no production buildings means the fast Castle
2 spears at your gold means a gold cut

pairings.why: Their army in about 95% of games.

winConditions.detail: An early Castle army of mounted samurai.
Farmhouses and a second Town Center into Imperial.

howToBeat: Knights Templar players use 1 TC aggression to force them into Feudal units.
